name: Cable Stability Ball Chest Press
steps: Hold a handle from each low pulley, sit on a stability ball, and walk your feet forward into a bridge.
Rest your upper back and head on the ball with hips lifted level and handles beside your chest.
Press both handles upward and slightly together above your chest until your arms straighten.
Bend your elbows under control to lower the handles back beside your chest.
tips: Keep your feet wide enough to hold the ball steady.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips lifted instead of letting them sag.
